title: Entropy decoding in Oodle Data: x86-64 3-stream Huffman decoders
relevance: Primary reference. Details the 3-stream Huffman decode loop for Skylake, achieving ~2.79 cycles/byte. Analyzes critical-path latency, register allocation, and uOp utilization.

title: Interleaved entropy coders
relevance: Theoretical foundation for interleaving multiple entropy decoder instances. Shows how interleaving without additional metadata can be implemented for any entropy coder.

title: Entropy coding in Oodle Data: Huffman coding
relevance: Introduction to Oodle's Huffman coding design: 11-bit tables, 5 decodes per refill, multi-stream architecture.

title: Faster zlib/DEFLATE decompression on the Apple M1 (and x86)
relevance: Demonstrates 1.5x speedup over zlib-cloudflare on M1 through ILP optimization of the decode loop. Key techniques: bigger root tables, combined bit shifts, fast-path literals, latency overlap.

title: Reading bits in far too many ways (part 1-3)
relevance: Exhaustive analysis of bit-reading strategies and their latency characteristics. Variant 4 (unconditional refill) is optimal for multi-stream decode.
